snippet.title: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven | Xbox and Windows Launch Trailer | Tokyo Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is now on Xbox Series X|S! https://www.xbox.com/games/store/game/9N84F48BNQ5V

Take the throne as the Emperor of Varennes and defend your Empire against the Seven Heroes!  Master battle systems like Glimmers and Formations and forge your own path through history.

A free demo is also available! Play the opening part and transfer your saved data over to the full game when you are ready to take on the Seven Heroes.

Demo: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/game/9N26RRCGFF22
